items.title: SCULPTURAL HAMMERED BRASS SCROLL SCONCE
items.description: A statement architectural wall sconce formed from an overlapping curved scroll of solid brass, hand-hammered with a shimmering dimpled texture.

items.title: ISLAMIC STAR FILIGREE ROUND MIRROR
items.description: A monumental circular wall mirror encircled by a wide, hand-pierced solid brass frame adorned with interlaced Islamic star patterns and arabesque filigree.

items.title: STAGGERED BRASS PLATE CYLINDER TABLE
items.description: A sculptural drum side table featuring a clear glass top supported by an architectural cylinder of vertical brass rods and staggered patinated rectangular plates.

items.title: CIRCULAR COBBLESTONE BRASS DOOR PULLS
items.description: A monumental pair of semicircular entry door handles cast in solid brass, featuring deep organic cobblestone relief texturing.

items.title: BOTANICAL BRASS & MARBLE BALUSTRADE
items.description: An architectural parapet featuring intricate pierced brass leaf screens framed by rich Italian rouge marble.

items.title: ROYAL ARABESQUE BRASS WALL CHARGER
items.description: A monumental wall-mounted circular charger hand-etched in solid brass, featuring intricate classical Islamic floral arabesques and radiating star medallions.

items.title: SCULPTURAL BOTANICAL URN BRASS RELIEF
items.description: A monumental sculptural brass wall plaque featuring an opulent bouquet of dimensional botanical foliage and blooming flora emerging from a hand-textured vase.

items.title: AMBER SCALLOP ARCHITECTURAL BRASS SCREEN
items.description: A tall architectural brass partition screen featuring an organic cascading pattern of artisan scalloped fish-scale panels in antique amber glass and solid brass framing.

items.title: SCULPTURAL FLUID BRASS VESSEL PAIR
items.description: A pair of sculptural tabletop bowls hand-cast in solid brass, featuring freeform undulating rims and a warm hand-buffed golden bronze patina.
